label: No two NECESSARY_2 concreta support each other, each at some admitted world
paraphrase: For no concrete candidates a and b, each existing at every world accessible from w, and worlds v and u, does a exist at v and stand to b in the selected relation at v while b exists at u and stands to a in the selected relation at u. The negation of the recorded mutual-support rival; with a = b it also excludes self-support at any world. It does not exclude longer cross-world cycles or endless descent.
